name: tenstorrent-skills
description: Tenstorrent skills and workflows for tt-metal development.

plugins.name: tt-skills
plugins.description: Finds relevant Tenstorrent plugins without installing or invoking them automatically.

plugins.name: tt-review-skills
plugins.description: Tenstorrent domain-knowledge code-review skills for gh-aw, Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: tt-autodebug
plugins.description: Adds skills that debug code issues (AutoDebug) and hangs (AutoTriage) by inspection without running the target code, plus a tenacious AutoFix workflow that tests hypotheses until it finds and addresses the root cause.

plugins.name: tt-model-bringup
plugins.description: Staged TTNN model bring-up; requires tt-autodebug. Codex runs add optional telemetry when tenstorrent/ar-dashboard is accessible.

plugins.name: tt-debug-tools
plugins.description: Drive the Tenstorrent debug tools and read their output: tt-triage, dprint, watcher, asserts, etc.
